original_text: We adopt the method described in \cite{chimebeam} to measure the primary beam in the E-W direction.
injected_text: We adopt the holographic method described in \cite{chimebeam} to measure the primary beam in the E-W direction.
rationale: The cited CHIME paper presents a Sun-tracking beamforming technique to measure the primary beam, not a holographic technique (which uses a reference antenna). Inserting 'holographic' mis-categorizes the method while keeping the cite key intact, so a verifier reading chimebeam would return CONTRADICTED.
ground_truth_description: Inserted 'holographic' before 'method' in the sentence adopting the CHIME beam-measurement technique, mis-categorizing CHIME's beamforming/Sun-tracking method as a holographic one.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: We adopt the method described in \cite{chimebeam} to measure the primary beam in the E-W direction.

original_text: The center frequency of the TCPA is 750 MHz, corresponding to a wavelength $\lambda$ of 0.4 m, the baseline length $L$ should ideally not exceed 22.9 m to satisfy this requirement.
injected_text: The center frequency of the TCPA is 750 MHz, corresponding to a wavelength $\lambda$ of 0.4 m, the baseline length $L$ should ideally not exceed 45.8 m to satisfy this requirement.
rationale: All three operands of the angular-resolution ratio (lambda=0.4 m, L_max, theta=1 deg) are stated explicitly in adjacent prose; doubling L_max to 45.8 m makes lambda/L = 0.5 deg, contradicting the theta>1 deg cut by a factor of two -- a blatant ratio_eq failure (~50% relative error) that upgrades to MAJOR.
ground_truth_description: Replaced the maximum baseline length consistent with theta > 1 deg from 22.9 m to 45.8 m, breaking the explicit lambda/L = theta arithmetic by a factor of 2.

truth.location_cue: wavelength $\lambda$ of 0.4 m, the baseline length $L$ should ideally not exceed 45.8 m to satisfy this requirement
truth.quantity_label: Maximum baseline length L for angular resolution theta = lambda/L > 1 deg at lambda = 0.4 m
